item.title: Osaka Conveyor-Belt Sushi: Kaitenzushi Done Right — Guide
item.description: Conveyor-belt sushi, kaitenzushi, is one of the most approachable meals in Osaka and a favourite with families and travellers alike. Plates of sushi circle the room on a belt while a touch-screen at your seat lets you order anything made fresh to arrive on an express lane; you take what you want, and the bill is tallied from the stacked plates, colour-coded by price. Osaka, obsessed with cheap and cheerful eating, does this exceptionally well, from bargain nationwide chains to specialist counters using good fish from the nearby markets — a low-stress, no-reservation meal at almost any hour.
